method.cpu: process CPU seconds / wall seconds; 100% is one logical core; excludes child CPU
method.gpu: deduplicated /proc/PID/fdinfo drm-engine nanoseconds; not VRAM, energy or GPU timestamp queries
method.host_stages: opt-in cumulative foreground elapsed ns; paint includes its render children
method.steady: one second excluded at each phase boundary; profiles use snapshots inside that interval
method.clock: current AMD DPM clock sampled about every 50ms for later runs; not locked or sufficient to normalize GPU durations
method.uninstrumented_control: previous release probe with same production terminal renderer; predates main rail changes; no terminal stage spans
method.excluded: probe-straight-20-a stopped during warmup due to an initial log-parser error; not included
